batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c YV Takawale b MA Starc

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b AB Dinda

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c M Morkel b SP Narine

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b SP Narine

balls.text: Uthappa ends the innings the way he's played this season, lofts a full toss with a straight bat high over the bowler
slices a slow pitched up ball over point, Yuvraj gives up the chase as Chahal sprints across from sweeper cover, he gets to it with a dive, but it touches him after he falls onto the rope
Uthappa pushes a low full toss to Starc, he half-stops it with his boot, Uthappa wants the single but Tendo sends him back as Starc rushes towards the ball
a sharp short ball angled in to the right-hander, who cannot connect on the hook, they take the bye
heaves at a length ball outside off, thick inside edge rolls left of the keeper
low full toss outside off placed through extra cover for two more
goes full, outside off, under the bat, and Tendo smashes it over wide long on with a fearsome connection

Tendo square-drives crisply but straight to cover, Uthappa is a long way up and seems to have no chance of returning, the throw comes to the bowler, he tries to lob it into the stumps, but misses, Uthappa smiles
tries the same stroke again, he is a long way outside off, the length ball is angled in, Shakib tries to reach fine leg again, misses and the off stump is rattled
tries to scoop it to fine leg as he walks outside off but misses this wide full toss
full toss just outside off, swung along the ground to long on
walks across to a full one around off and works it through midwicket
Uthappa does not need to slog at anything, this is full and wide, he moves forward and drives in the air through extra cover, that rockets to the boundary
moves across and tries to flay this pitched up ball through midwicket but cannot manage much of a connection
full just outside off to the right hander, Uthapp cannot get underneath it and squeezes it towards long on
closer to off stump on this full delivery, Shakib drills it hard past the bowler, long on tumbles over the rope as he keeps the ball in, long off is around to throw it back
four more, he walks outside off stump expecting it wide from Dinda, it arrives there on a length and Shakib hammers it to the deep point boundary
goes way outside off stump with the angle across the left hander
boundary first ball of the over as Shakib reaches fifty of 32, his first half-century in the IPL we are told on air, a full and wide one from Dinda and Shakib smears it through extra cover
superb placement, Starc goes full outside off, Uthappa leans forward and opens the face to send it racing to the right of cover
digs it in shortish but the angle takes it down the leg side, even as Uthappa swings and misses
141.6 kph full outside off, Uthappa goes hard at it, and mistimes it to the bowler
slow and full on middle and leg, Shakib is outside off to try and go to short fine leg, but it hits the toe end and rolls square on the leg side
a low full toss, Uthappa opens the face but he cannot place it past backward point
comes down the track to a slow, full delivery and can only squeeze it out to cover
and first ball Uthappa tries to drive on the up through the off side but mistimes the length ball towards cover
waits on this one outside off a tad as he tries to find the gap but fails to beat cover again
that was a boundary had it beaten cover, a full and wide one and Shakib reaches it to smash a powerful drive
swings in a tad in the blockhole on off, Uthappa digs it out to long off
full length on off stump, Uthappa times the clip superbly through midwicket and AB has to dive at wide long on to save the boundary
in the blockhole on off, Uthappa turns it square, and it goes slowly enough to allow them room to come back for two
four more, full and wide outside off, Uthappa reaches it and opens the face to drive it in the air well behind point, and also beats third man easily
Shakib is hurting RCB big time, Chahal goes outside off to try and deny him, but Shakib picks it from there and slogs it over wide long on
leaves the crease once more and slogs a flat one straight to the bowler, it bursts through but he recovers to deny them the single
he sees him coming and bowls it into the pad but Shakib is still able to generate plenty of momentum on the swing and lifts it clean over deep midwicket, 89 metres this one, big sixes these
shortens the length as Shakib comes out again, he dabs it wide of the sweeper for two more
another boundary, now Shakib steps out, reaches the pitch and sends it soaring into the crowd beyond the long on boundary, that went 97 metres
Shakib's cranked up and smeared this flat legbreak straight past the bowler
a yorker outside off, Shakib guides it behind square but cannot beat third man
inches short of AB at long on as Uthappa lofts a full ball, but even if he had caught it, it would have made no difference as no-ball had already been called
Shakib steps out to a pitched up ball going across him, but he cannot time it as he tries to smash it through the off side, sweeper fields
a loopy full slower ball outside off from the back of the hand, Uthappa reaches his fifth fifty of the season with a drive to long off
full on the stumps now at 136.5 kph, slight swing in to Shakib, who turns it square on the leg side
another slower one cutting wide across the left-hander, Shakib swings and misses
walks a long way outside off and tries to lift this length ball to fine leg, but it is a slower one and he misses
taken from outside off and slogged down to long on
Shakib charges out to a wide one, he hasn't middled it, but done enough to pick up a one-bounce four into the straight boundary
angled in fullish this time and he works it through midwicket
slight appeal for leg before as Uthappa misses the sweep but this was turning away and missing off stump
lunges forward, this one does not turn as much as he expects, he adjusts to block
goes back to a tossed up fullish ball, and punches it back to the bowler
opens the face again to a wider one, but this travels squarer to third man
Uthappa goes past Maxwell as the leading run-getter this season with a deft steer to the fine third man boundary off this back of a length ball
pitched up but angled too much, into the pad, he gets away as Shakib swipes it to deep square leg
has width on this length ball outside off, but is disappointed he cannot connect with the late cut
walks out and has a heave at one angled in, mishits it to midwicket
length ball on the pad, Shakib waits and whips this hard past midwicket, Starc runs from deep square leg and dives, but it's already hit the rope by then
angled in full towards middle and leg, Shakib works it square
worked to deep midwicket for a single
flighted. but down the leg side, and Uthappa's sweep is well to the left of Gayle at short fine leg, that is enough
turned softly and square on the leg side for a couple
sweeps a full one behind square leg for one
nicely bowled, he plays back to a tossed up offbreak that leaves him just outside off to beat the outside edge
he brings out the reverse sweep to a full one just outside off, and beats short third man's dive with a crisp connection
beaten as he pushes at a legbreak outside off
comes down the track and turns it to long on for a single
Uthappa shows off his touch once more, he skips to the pitch of the ball and lifts it dead straight with a straight followthrough over the boundary
Shakib steps out and opens the face to chip a googly in the air to wide long off
moves outside the crease, gets too close to the pitch of the ball, and squeezes it down the ground for one
tries to drag a flat one through midwicket, but the thick inside edge goes fine on the leg side instead
slides it across the left-hander and Shakib cuts it in typical style behind point, work for the sweeper
Shakib works this close to the pitch on the leg side and sets off, but Uthappa rightly sends him back as Yuvraj gets to the ball
drives along the ground to wide long off now
shot, Uthappa moves back leg to the on side and drives a full delivery in the air, just past extra cover and into the gap to the left of long off
finally succeeds in getting the single as he opens the face and guides it to short third man
gets forward again, opens the face but cannot get the single as backward point reaches the ball
lunges forward to a bouncing legbreak and pushes it behind point
makes some room to a flat legbreak on middle and guides it square on the off side
full outside leg stump, Uthappa clips it to deep midwicket
a low full toss, Uthappa chips it over the bowler and times it well enough to beat long off running across

Yusuf's gifted his wicket away, he pushed to cover and set off for a non-existent single, Kohli ran in and lobbed the ball to the keeper, Yusuf dived back and should have made it, but his bat was in the air as the keeper took the bails off
taps it to short third man, there is a direct hit, and they take one more off the ricochet
tries to whip it to midwicket again, but almost pops it back to the bower
Yuvraj goes flat and angles it in next ball, Yusuf pushes it softly to vacant midwicket and they have time to take two
flights it again outside off, Yusuf reaches it with a big forward stride and slams it into the straight boundary
tosses it up, just outside off, Uthappa pushes forward and eases it to cover
beats him now with one that does not turn as it goes across the right-hander, who pushes forward expecting spin
tosses it up full on the pad, Yusuf lunges forward, gets down and sweeps it just over the deep backward square leg rope
defended off the front foot to the bowler
Uthappa survives, he skips out and chips a flighted ball towards mid off, Dinda runs forward to his right and dives, but it falls just short
tosses it up well down the leg side, Uthappa misses as he tries to nudge it fine
comes across and works a flat good length offbreak to square leg
gets away with a tossed up ball down the leg side as Uthappa sweeps straight to short fine leg
comes forward and across and pushes a length length ball to the right of mid on for one
arches back a bit and steers a length ball outside off to third man
nudges this back of a length ball to midwicket, Uthappa wants the single and is halfway up the pitch before he turns back
plays out a length ball towards point
Yusuf is away first ball as he lifts this length delivery off his pad in front of square leg
could have been close as Uthappa is hit on the pad as he shuffles across just outside the crease, Nechim moves it in to beat the bat, but that hit the pad quite high, well above the knee roll

another mistimed shot, and this could have been dangerous, Uthappa came forward to try the drive again but it seemed to stop on him, and he ended up popping it towards mid off, fell well short, and Kohli had a go at the non-striker's stumps with no chance of catching Uthappa short, concedes four overthrows
tries to drive this length ball on the up but checks his shot to the bowler as he cannot time it
Pandey picks out another fielder, and this time on the full, he slashes at a bouncing length delivery, Starc moves quickly to his right at third man and takes the catch
and again, he moves outside off stump in the crease now, Dinda goes wider, and Pandey slaps it straight to cover once more
Pandey walks down the track and outside off stump but cannot push a length ball past cover
tight start to the over with a length ball climbing around off, Uthappa is quick on the front foot and pushes it towards mid on for a single
finally hits the gap as he goes leg side this time, and forces a pitched up delivery through midwicket
a slower one, bowled very wide again, Pandey stretches for it, connects again, but picks out cover now
had the width on this full delivery, also created some by pushing back leg towards the on side, but thumped it straight to Gayle at cover-point
nicely across and forward to push a length delivery to cover for one
Pandey in no control of the front-foot pull as Starc digs it short of a length at nearly 147 kph, it pops up in front of square
Starc pitches it up just outside off, Uthappa flows forward and pushes it to the left of mid off for one, some inswing for Starc there
Pandey survives again, he pushes uncertainly at a length ball outside off, and the thick inside edge flies to the fine leg boundary
bouncer now, well outside off, Pandey tries to hook weeakly, misses, it is over his head and called a wide for height
loose, Pandey follows this from the crease as it kicks and jags away from short of a length, and is beaten
now he takes a couple of steps down the track, but can only play out the length ball to point
Pandey is away, opens the face on this full and wide outswinger and eases it between cover-point and cover
hits it in the air as he pushes at a length ball moving away and rising, falls well short of point though
pitches it up just outside off to start, Uthappa moves forward and pushes solidly to mid on
gets a short of a length ball, hops and brings it down onto the pitch

second time Starc goes down the leg side to Gambhir, and this time he's gifted with the captain's wicket, a short of a length delivery climbs a bit, Gambhir tries to tickle it fine again, but only nicks it through to the keeper
back of a length, moving away outside off, Gambhir tries to dab it late, is beaten
gets the line right, bowls it full just outside off, swings away a touch, Gambhir pushes it to point
slips this length ball into the left-hander's pads, and Gambhir happily tickles it fine
starts good length, just outside off, moves it in a tad, Uthappa leans forward and taps it softly to get off the mark
Starc swings and misses a wide length ball, and that is the end for RCB
in the blockhole just outside off, hit hard into the pitch and bounces over the bowler
full around leg, driven straight down the ground
flicks off the pad wide of fine leg for two
cracks a pitched up ball powerfully to the right of long off for a boundary
makes room and lifts a full delivery that bounces just short of extra cover and goes past him
very full just outside off stump, smashed straight back to the bowler
full one outside off flashed to extra cover, who cannot stop it
over short fine leg, walks outside off and lifts a full ball over the man in the ring

very high full toss heaved wide of deep midwicket, it is a no-ball for height, there is an appeal for run-out, Uthappa does well to gather the wide throw one-handed and whip the bails off, but batsman has just made it
full and outside off, thick inside edge goes square on the leg side as Starc looks to go off side
low full toss guided wide of the sweeper
pitched up outside off, swung hard on the bounce to long off
full around off, driven to long off
length ball angled in to the left hander from round the stumps, Starc misses
dropped as Rana flashes a full and wide one to the bowler's left, Vinay stretches but can't hold on
heaves and edges it over and in the gap between short third man and backward point
full toss smeared down the ground for a couple
full outside off, driven to extra cover
that should be game, set and match, Sunil Narine takes his fourth wicket, AB bends down for the sweep, the ball pitches good length and carries on straight past the bat-swing to hit off stump
AB jumps out, but it only pops up in front of square as he swings hard, got too close to it
straighter one bounces on off, is pushed to backward point for a single
backs away to leg and flashes this length ball to wide long off
Narine delivers yet again, Yuvraj tees off on this full delivery, but picks out Vinay at the long on boundary
stands outside off before the ball is delivered, drags the straighter one to long on
loses his shape as he tries to hit this low full toss outside off, it goes through midwicket
and another boundary, full and wide once more, but Yuvraj reaches it this time, and jabs it fine past the keeper
goes full and wide outside off, and Yuvraj misses this time
six more, Umesh angles it in on a length, and Yuvraj uses that to pick it flat over deep backward  square leg, superb timing
four more, Yuvraj shuffles across, Umesh bowls it full outside leg stump, and it hits the pad to race fine
six first ball, short of a length sitting up on the pads at 121 kph, Yuvraj sends it soaring effortlessly over deep square leg
can't finish well, bowls a full toss into the pad, and AB bends back leg and gets it away to the fine leg boundary
moves outside off this time, but swings and misses again as Morne finds some away shape on the full deliveyr
walks across and tries to slog-sweep, Morne bowls the offcutter and beats him
dropped, by the bowler as he stretches out his left hand after Yuvraj flays a wide one straight back
another length ball, hits it hard along the ground to long on
shuffles across to off, and has a go at this length ball, mishits it hard into the pitch
top spell from Shakib comes to an end, AB cannot get under this full delivery and drags it to long on
AB goes a long way outside leg, Shakib goes in the blockhole , AB drags it out
heaves at a full one outside off, hits it along the ground to long on
hurls it full and way down the leg side from over the stumps
backs away again and flashes it through the off side to the sweeper now
makes room outside leg stump and sweeps a low full toss, Tendo runs to his right from deep midwicket to stop it with a slide
full in the blockhole outside off, jabbed square
Narine makes another dent., offbreak spins in sharply from outside off, Takawale still tries to cut, chops it on
length delivery punched down to long off
and beaten first ball as he pushes forward at a sharp offbreak
Narine strikes, Kohli cuts hard, but this is not wide enough and is bouncing too, Morne tumbles to his left at short third man to take it
how did that miss off stump, carom ball spins away from Kohli, opens him up, past the outside edge, clips the thigh pad, left him absolutely clueless
full delivery on the pad, worked wide of deep midwicket for two more
full delivery squeezed to the left of the sweeper for two
sees him making room early, and bowls it full and wide outside off, Takawale can't do anything with it
skips out, takes it on the full, swats it down the track, bowler cannot stop it
finally Kohli gets Shakib away, over the deep midwicket boundary, as he moves to the leg side and slogs a full delivery, 94 metres that
Kohli charges out, takes it on the full but all the angle on the ball takes it to deep midwicket after batsman swipes
slogs and top-edges over midwicket, but it falls in vacant space just in front of two deep fielders running in
cuts another carom ball but cannot time it past backward point
he dabs the straighter one to Morne's right at short third man, the fast bowler puts in the dive and stops the ball
offbreak comes in from outside off, worked with the turn to deep midwicket
straighter length ball turned to midwicket for a single
sharp offbreak spins in and hits him on the pad outside leg stump as he misses the whip
leaves the crease once more, turns it to deep midwicket
takes it on the full to push down to long off for one
full and angled down the pads, Kohli cannot get it away once more
slides in to Kohli who hits it to point
full and quick just outside off, he heaves, the ball rolls square on the leg side
skips out and moves to the leg side trying to go over extra cover, but is too close to the pitch to be able to find any timing on it, jabs it past the bowler in the end
takes a step out and pushes a length ball to the off side for a single
full and into the pad, rolls away behind square leg as Takawale misses
more width, more runs, Takawale stays in the crease and cuts in the air to the backward point boundary
Vinay goes for more runs, this is wide outside off, and Takawale hops as he slashes it over point, all the way over the boundary
length ball just outside off, he stays back and pushes it to the leg side, Vinay cannot cut it off and they take the single
charges out first ball of the over and flays the length ball through the covers, too fast for the sweeper
Kohli comes out, but cannot place the drive through extra cover as he gets too close to the pitch, takes the single to long off
leaves the crease again and nudges it with the angle behind square
walks down the track and is hit on the pad with another one angled in
fired into the pad, turned square
goes back as he sees this pitching on a length, it does not turn and hurries in, Kohli keeps it out in time
tosses up slowly just outside off, he opens the face to turn it to third man
skips down the track, Vinay shortens the length, Takawale stops and steers it to third man
short of a length just outside off, dabbed to third man
sends it full into the pads, and Kohli happily clips it in front of square, it races to the rope, easily beating deep midwicket
just short of a length, moving away, tapped in front of backward point for a single
wide length ball dabbed to the right of third man, Umesh clumsily stops it with a dive
is confused by this slower one that cuts in from short of a length, but takes the single as the ball rolls close to the pitch on off
quick and straight on middle at 99 kph, defended back
holds the line on a good length, around off stump, worked in front of square on the leg side
hit on the pad with a full delivery as he misses while trying to turn it to midwicket
another carom ball, outside off, turned to midwicket
straighter one jabbed behind point, he is not getting the single
sends it way down the leg side first up and Takawale gets some bat on it to send it fine
short of a length into the pad, pops up to short fine leg
four more, Morkel goes short this time, Takawale arches back and guides it over slip
Tendo and Pandey are running back after this skier from covers as Takawale slogs at a pitched up delivery, but they dash into each other, and the ball rolls away into the rope
defends a 147 kph good length delivery to covers
he connects this time, Morkel pitches it up outside off, and Takawale clears mid off by some distance
comes down the track, has a heave and misses this 145.5 kph back of a length ball slanted in to him
a length ball just outside off to end the over, Kohli pushes to covers
Kohli takes charge this time, this is overpitched at 140.8 kph, and he swats it straight over the bowler, for a one-bounce four
another shout for lbw as Takawale is pinned on the crease against this length ball that moves in further after pitching, but he's managed a thick inside edge before
short of a length at 137.9 kph, Kohli tucks it to long leg
Kohli escapes, he saw this angled in full into the pad and tried to clip it square, got a leading edge, right in the gap between cover and extra cover
late away swing as Umesh pitches it up at 136.5 kph, Kohli covers for that, and drives to mid off
pitches it up now, nearly 148 kph, Takawale probably not expecting the fuller length and pops it in the air, but no harm done as it rolls to mid on
steepler just outside off at 141.5 kph, Takawale tries to guide it over the keeper, but misses again
width on offer, but it is a slower one at 129 kph, and Takawale cannot connect on the cut
that comes in, is climbing too, Kohli handles it well, softly turning it square
wide one from short of a length, Kohli tries to place it past backward point, but cannot beat the man
just back of a length, he defends towards extra cover and starts early for the single, nicely judged

Umesh has got the big wicket in his first over, the umpire takes his time before slowly raising the finger, length ball, pitching middle, moving in a bit and hitting him dead in front around the knee roll as Gayle is caught heavy-footed on the crease
short of a length now, and Gayle whips, one leg high in the air, in front of square, and beats deep square leg
nice line, a length ball ending around off stump, Gayle defends from the crease
moving away again, steered to third man for a single
good length ball swings away and bounces, he half-prods at it, well inside the line
short of a length and moving into Gayle, he jabs it square on the leg side for one
climbs steeply and moves away from back of a length outside off, left alone
length ball on the pads, Gayle turns it to fine leg
short of a length into the body now, Gayle carefully nudges it to square leg
pitches it up this time, 147 kph, Gayle lets it go outside off with the angle
and again, pushes well inside the line as a similar back of a length ball leaves him close to off
beaten first ball with a 144 kph short of a length ball that jags away past the outside edge by some distance
